profile.formality: Two levels of you: vous (formal, and also the plural) and tu (familiar). Use vous with strangers, staff and elders. Wait to be invited to use tu.
profile.script: Latin with accents: é è ê à ç. Many final consonants are silent. Nasal vowels (on, an, in) need attention.
profile.questionWords: quoi, où, quand, qui, pourquoi, comment, combien
profile.agreement: Nouns are masculine or feminine. Adjectives and past participles agree in gender and number: enchanté / enchantée.
profile.conjugation: Verbs change with person. The vous and tu forms differ: vous allez, tu vas.
profile.wordOrder: Subject–verb–object, as in English. Object pronouns go before the verb.
